# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: review-gift-kit-flexible-evidence
  version: "2.0.0"
  title: Review gift-kit records
  description: "A fictional campaign review: interpret scoped checks, compare complete corrective arrangements, and finish before the handoff cutoff."
  question: "What corrections do these gift-kit checks establish?"
  boundary: Only the published configurations and check predictions for one exact batch and journey revision.
  assumptions: [Current scoped reports are treated as accurate under the author-declared possible outcomes., "All declared joint fault configurations remain possible until excluded by reports; none has an implied probability.", An unreadable printed code can conceal its destination. Planned corrections do not establish successful completion., "Input acceptance records a named role judgment; it does not authenticate identity or issue permission."]
  parameters:
    - id: nowMinute
      type: integer
      min: 0
      label: Review time in whole minutes from the declared origin
  relations:
    - id: expectedScope
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [field]
    - id: state
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: stateFault
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: fault
          type: string
      key: [state, fault]
    - id: stateCorrection
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: correction
          type: string
      key: [state, correction]
    - id: checkOutcome
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
      key: [check, outcome]
    - id: prediction
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
      key: [state, check, outcome]
    - id: correction
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: observation
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
        - id: observed
          type: integer
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: person
          type: string
        - id: text
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: recordScope
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [record, field]
    - id: wrongScope
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: futureRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: usedRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
    - id: recordDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: disposition
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: stateMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: check
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
    - id: ruledOutState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
    - id: remainingState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
    - id: possibleCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: absentCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: variableCorrection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: correction
          type: string
    - id: requiredCorrection

          type: string

          type: boolean
    - id: correctionsEstablished

          type: boolean
  rules:
    - id: RECORD.SCOPE.MISSING
      head:
        relation: wrongScope
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome", "?observed", "?source", "?person", "?text"]
        - relation: expectedScope
          args: ["?field", "?expected"]
        - op: notExists

            relation: recordScope
            args: ["?record", "?field", "?expected"]
    - id: RECORD.SCOPE.EXTRA

        relation: wrongScope
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: recordScope
          args: ["?record", "?field", "?value"]
        - op: notExists

            relation: expectedScope
            args: ["?field", "?value"]
    - id: RECORD.FUTURE

    - id: RECORD.WRONG.SCOPE.DISPOSITION

    - id: RECORD.FUTURE.DISPOSITION

          args: ["?record"]
        - op: notExists

            relation: wrongScope

    - id: RECORD.USED.DISPOSITION
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", used, current-scoped-report, The report is used under the published check predictions for this exact scope.]
      body:
        - relation: usedRecord
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.REPORT.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: stateMismatch
        args: ["?state", "?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
      body:
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: usedRecord
          args: ["?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: prediction
            args: ["?state", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.RULED.OUT
      head:
        relation: ruledOutState
        args: ["?state"]
      body:
        - relation: stateMismatch
          args: ["?state", "?record", "?check", "?outcome"]
    - id: STATE.REMAINS
      head:
        relation: remainingState
        args: ["?state", "?label"]
      body:
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: ruledOutState
            args: ["?state"]
    - id: CORRECTION.POSSIBLE
      head:
        relation: possibleCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: stateCorrection
          args: ["?state", "?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.ABSENT

        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
        - relation: correction
          args: ["?correction"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: stateCorrection
            args: ["?state", "?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.VARIES
      head:
        relation: variableCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: possibleCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]
        - relation: absentCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]
    - id: BASIS.NONEMPTY
      head:
        relation: hasRemainingState
        args: [true]
      body:
        - relation: remainingState
          args: ["?state", "?label"]
    - id: CORRECTIONS.ESTABLISHED
      head:
        relation: correctionsEstablished
        args: [true]
      body:
        - relation: hasRemainingState
          args: [true]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: variableCorrection
            args: ["?correction"]
    - id: CORRECTION.REQUIRED
      head:
        relation: requiredCorrection
        args: ["?correction"]
      body:
        - relation: correctionsEstablished
          args: [true]
        - relation: possibleCorrection
          args: ["?correction"]

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.

# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.

module:
  id: review-gift-kit-flexible-planning

  description: "Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work."

      domain:
        id: gifting-operations
        label: Gifting operations
      useCase:
        id: prepare-gift-kit-campaign
        label: Prepare a gift-kit campaign
    gifting:
      profileId: gift-kit-readiness
      profileVersion: "1.0.0"
      packages:
        - id: rehearse-unchanged
          label: "Prepare, rehearse and hand off unchanged kits"
          corrects: []
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: reprint
          label: Replace the printed inserts
          corrects: [replace-insert]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: repair-journey
          label: Correct the destination and checkout
          corrects: [correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: replace-and-repair
          label: Replace inserts and repair the journey
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: external-replace-and-repair
          label: External replacement and journey repair
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: true
      checks:
        - id: declared-fault-state
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Use an admitted configuration from the published fault catalog
          evidence: A current scoped evidence assessment admitting this fault configuration.
        - id: published-package-effects
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Retain the published correction effects of the selected package
          evidence: The author-fixed correction effects from this exact published package version.
        - id: correct-fault-0
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The printed code cannot be read whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The printed code cannot be read, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-1
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The code leads to the wrong destination whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The code leads to the wrong destination, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-2
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The intended checkout is restricted whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The intended checkout is restricted, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: known-owner
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Assign the complete work to a recorded responsible person
          evidence: A recorded person responsible for this complete correction package.
        - id: scoped-package-permission
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Hold recorded authority for this package, person, exact configuration, and whole working interval"
          evidence: "A sourced permission for the selected package and person, matching all six scope fields and covering correction through handoff."
        - id: resource-calendar
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Keep the full correction, rehearsal, and handoff within resource availability"
          evidence: An availability interval covering the complete proposed work.
        - id: resource-capacity
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Keep all proposed work within recorded resource capacity
          evidence: Enough recorded resource capacity throughout the proposed work.
        - id: not-in-past
          requirement: TIME
          label: Start correction at or after the current review time
          evidence: A current proposed start time.
        - id: handoff-by-cutoff
          requirement: TIME
          label: "Finish correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff before the kit commitment cutoff"
          evidence: "Durations and resource availability that fit the cutoff, or a revised commitment."
        - id: package-within-budget
          requirement: COST
          label: Keep the complete proposed package within the recorded spending ceiling
          evidence: "A current package quote within the spending ceiling, or an approved revised ceiling."
        - id: quoted-quantity
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Use a complete-package quote for the current kit quantity
          evidence: A current complete-package quote and duration explicitly covering the stated kit quantity.
        - id: minimum-rehearsal
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Allow at least the published minimum duration for the scoped rehearsal
          evidence: "A proposed scoped rehearsal duration meeting the published minimum. This remains a plan, not evidence that rehearsal passed."
        - id: scoped-package-confirmation
          requirement: CONFIRMATION
          label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
          evidence: "A sourced positive package confirmation, recorded by a named person, for this exact batch, insert, destination, checkout, device and account, effective at the planned start and valid through handoff."

Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.", "Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.", An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid
